name: 🚀 The Space Simulator
desc:
- Collect every Orb to unlock VIP status! 👑
- The Season changes every Saturday morning, bringing new Centaur asteroids with Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic items! 🎁

Explore the Solar System 🚀 together with friends!
Visit the Moon, The Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn 🪐, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Haumea, Makemake, Eris, Sedna, Planet X, famous moons and asteroids. 

Master movements in Zero gravity, use the Hubble Telescope 🛰️,  visit the International Space station, take a sample from Halley's Comet ☄️, respond to distress signals to save your fellow astronauts, uncover hidden places and search for Alien life! 👽

👍Like the game and ✅ join our group:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/32973823/SpaceSim

Roblox Plus members get 15% increase in the speed of the Spaceships.

All kinds of cheating, speed hacks, and similar exploits are strictly forbidden.

Tags: Open world, Sandbox, Planets, Spaceships, Rockets, Comets, Roleplay, Adventure, Sun, Asteroids, Stars
